`checkoutservice` is spiking. Labels help you see which dimension is driving that.

The **Labels** tab shows the labels for this service under the selected profile type (CPU in this case).

To investigate with labels, complete the following steps:
The `checkoutservice` panel has some huge spikes. Click **Labels** on the panel to explore it further.
In the **Search labels** field, type `region` so the **region** panel is on screen. If you already see it, click **Skip**.

At a glance, one region is using a lot more CPU than the other two. Click **Select** on the **region** panel.

That gives each region its own panel so you can compare CPU usage side by side.
Look at the separate region panels. `ap-south-1` and `us-east-2` have similar CPU usage, but `eu-west-1` uses quite a bit more. That points to `eu-west-1` as the place to investigate next.
You've isolated the problem to a single region. Next, you'll pinpoint the exact function responsible.
